title: Overlapping Matches
prompt:
**Problem.** Lines of: p t. Print, per line, the number of
OVERLAPPING occurrences of p in t.

**Constraints:** up to 200 lines; 1 ≤ |p| ≤ 5; 1 ≤ |t| ≤ 1000.

Z on p + '#' + t; count every position with z[i] >= |p|.

tests.name: basic
no match
tests.hint: Pattern longer than text or absent: 0.

tests.name: load: 200 pairs
tests.hint: Z-based matching per pair: O(|t|) each. The W skips past matches and loses overlapping hits.
